findings.body: GeneralConfig(shutdown_drain_timeout=120.5) accepts and preserves the value, but shutdown still uses _SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_TIMEOUT, initialized solely from the environment or 60.0 in triggarr/search/scheduler.py:58–81 and passed to asyncio.timeout at line 634. Thus an operator configuring a longer drain still gets forced resource closure after 60 seconds. No runtime consumer reads the new field.
findings.recommendation: Use the active general.shutdown_drain_timeout as the shutdown default, preserving the environment override, and add an integration test proving a non-default configuration reaches the drain timeout.
